scope: CPU-only validation repair and cached isomer ranking; no encoder training, GPU inference, cloud run or submission
primary_panel: Previously consumed CASMI2022 positive160 and negative80
source_stress: Previously consumed acquisition-audited external80; evaluate full80 and predeclared raw-alias-free cohort without fitting on its outcomes
fresh_C13_metrics: Remain unread; no confirmation consumption authorized by this experiment
grouping: Transitive union of equal nonempty Murcko scaffold, truth-formula equality, Morgan radius2 Tanimoto>=0.70, and identical rounded peak signatures; exclude connected external-stress structures from CPU training
alpha_selection: Inner grouped OOF full-query MRR@25 only; ties prefer smaller alpha. No outer/stress selection.
ranking: Reorder only candidates sharing formula; retain each formula's occupied positions, candidate membership and official identity. Rank1 can change only within its formula. Protect complete parent when library_max>=0.90.
training_pairs: Truth versus same-formula decoys on training queries only; each eligible training query has equal total pair weight. No truth insertion; absent queries remain zero in every evaluation.
ablation: Without_physical removes ICEBERG, GLACIER and proxy fragmentation features; fixed settings, independently inner-selected alpha
public_control: Report complete P14/P15/P18/P19 without outcome-selected query filtering. A wrong-sign P14 point estimate blocks claims of leaderboard-calibrated validation.
promotion: No deployment or GPU spending follows this exploratory cycle automatically; independent confirmation and actual source-exposure review are separate requirements.
